name: GitHub Copilot Free

meters.label: AI Credits
meters.hint: Amount not published. Settings → Billing → AI usage shows what you've used.

reset.rule: Resets on the 1st of each calendar month at 00:00 UTC, whatever your billing date.
stipulations: Chat, Copilot CLI, cloud agent, Spaces, Spark, third-party agents and code review spend credits. Code completions and next edit suggestions don't.
Each model charges its own per-token API price. There are no multipliers and no free models.
Prices roughly double above the long-context threshold: 200K or 272K tokens, 100K for Claude Haiku 5.5.
Code review also uses GitHub Actions minutes.

meters.label: Code completions
meters.hint: 2,000 a month. Shown in the Copilot status menu in your IDE.

reset.rule: Monthly. GitHub doesn't say whether this resets on the 1st with credits or on another date.
stipulations: Counts code completions and next edit suggestions.
Paid plans have no completion limit.

overage: At either limit that feature stops until it resets. Free can't buy additional usage; upgrade to Pro or higher instead.

how: A small monthly AI Credits allowance for Chat and Copilot CLI. GitHub doesn't publish the amount.
2,000 code completions a month. Auto model selection only.
ext: Works in VS Code, Visual Studio, JetBrains, Xcode, Eclipse and Copilot CLI.
No cloud agent and no third-party agents (Claude Code, Codex) on Free.
quirks: You can't pick a model. Auto selection chooses for you.
Free gets the Standard Copilot Fusion tier only.
